intro: Upload a document or paste some text, and hear it read aloud.
hint_text: Up to {max} characters. You can paste text with Ctrl+V.
status_converting: Converting to speech… Please wait. Longer texts can take about a minute.
status_ready: Done! Press the ▶ button in the player to listen, or download the MP3 file.
error_empty_text: The text box is empty. Please paste or type some text.
error_text_too_long: The text is too long. Please shorten it to {max} characters.
error_unknown_voice: The chosen voice is not available. Please choose another voice.
error_bad_speed: The chosen speed is not allowed. Please choose another one.
error_bad_request: Something is wrong with the request. Please reload the page and try again.
error_conversion_failed: The conversion to speech did not work. Please try again.
error_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error_no_voices: No voices are available right now. Please try again later.
hint_file: PDF, EPUB, DOCX or TXT, up to {max} MB. You can also drag the file into this box with the mouse.
chapters_summary: Number of chapters: {count}. About {words} words in total. Listening time at normal speed: {duration}.
chapters_note_parts: No chapters were found in the file, so the text has been split into parts of about {words} words.
error_no_file: No file is selected. Please choose a file with the button.
error_unsupported_type: This type of file is not supported. Please choose a PDF, EPUB, DOCX or TXT file.
error_file_too_large: The file is too large. The maximum size is {max} MB.
error_empty_file: There is no text to read in this file.
error_scanned_pdf: This PDF seems to be scanned: it only contains pictures of pages, with no text. Such files cannot be read yet. Please try another version of the document (for example DOCX, or a PDF with text).
error_pdf_password: This PDF is protected with a password and cannot be read. Please upload a version without a password.
error_unreadable_file: The file cannot be read. It may be damaged. Please try another file.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please reload the page with Ctrl+F5 and try again.
error_no_speech: The text has no words that can be read aloud.
